actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.role: Senator of Brazil and defeated presidential candidate
actors.blurb: Flávio Bolsonaro remains the central figure of the current news cycle after fleeing Brazil for the United States following his presidential election defeat. From Miami, he has posted videos questioning the election results, declared himself the 'real president' of Brazil, and announced his intent to lead the opposition, triggering international scrutiny involving Donald Trump, Javier Milei, and diplomatic friction between Brazil and Argentina.

actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Giorgia Meloni is driving extensive European and domestic coverage as her government manages nationwide protests, defends its unwavering support for Ukraine despite political costs, and advances contentious security and budget measures. She has also faced intense public clashes with the judiciary over rulings regarding terrorism charges and migrant releases.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Javier Milei is generating significant regional and international controversy as his administration faces scrutiny over alleged logistical assistance provided to Flávio Bolsonaro during his flight to the US. Concurrently, Milei is preparing for his upcoming return to Spain for the Ibero-American Summit while managing domestic economic pressures, IMF negotiations, and rising social discontent.

actors.name: Marine Le Pen

Her party has also faced severe public blowback and legal challenges regarding the ideological fallout of recent violent extremist attacks in the Paris suburbs.

actors.name: Jimmie Åkesson
actors.blurb: Jimmie Åkesson is commanding prominent Swedish political coverage after forcefully intervening in an intense internal party ideological debate over ethnicity and nationalism. He publicly laid down the law against ethno-nationalist dissenters within the Sweden Democrats, firmly endorsing the party's official line on 'open Swedishness' and threatening non-compliant members with expulsion.
